read_fvecs_file: read a fvecs binary file and return float32 vectors as a numpy array
read_ivecs_file: read an ivecs binary file and return int32 vectors as a numpy array
mmap_fvecs_file: memory-map a fvecs binary file for efficient access without loading all data into RAM
write_fvecs_file: write a numpy array of float32 vectors to a fvecs binary file on disk
iterate_bvecs_batches: iterate over a bvecs file in memory-mapped batches to avoid loading the entire file
